$comment: 異體字 folding table — data, not code. Applied to textMatch only, after OpenCC conversion to Traditional. Folding is one-directional: variant -> canonical.
$provenance: Seed set drawn from well-attested Unihan kZVariant / kSemanticVariant relations and 教育部《異體字字典》. These are the forms that actually differ between chinese-poetry collections. NOT independently verified character-by-character — treat as provisional and audit before Phase 5 calibration.
$rule: Adding an entry requires a citation for the equivalence in the PR description (CONTRIBUTING.md). Two characters looking similar is not evidence. A wrong entry silently merges two distinct poems, and nothing in the pipeline will report it.
$excluded: Simplified<->Traditional pairs are NOT listed here. OpenCC handles those, and duplicating the mapping in two places is how the two paths drift apart.
